affected_predicate.description: A reply containing exactly 'Nice sharing, i love it' is posted as a reply to gourmet's toot about Moussaka.

competing_trace_defects.description: The step-16 click described as opening the gourmet toot instead opened gourmet's profile; the subsequent trajectory had to search within that profile.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the visible screen is titled 'New post' and contains only an @gourmet mention, not a reply context tied to the Moussaka toot. Step 20 types the requested text into that standalone composer. Step 21 sends it and returns to gourmet's timeline without any visible correction to a toot-specific reply flow. Step 22 then terminates on the false premise that the reply was posted. Thus the reused false interface premise is carried continuously through submission and false completion, while the required toot-specific reply remains visibly unsupported.

summary: The sole strict-MHR chain visibly carries a false reply-interface premise into typing and sending from a standalone New post composer addressed to @gourmet. No correction to a Moussaka-toot reply context is observed before termination. An earlier, independently observable click opened gourmet's profile instead of the claimed toot detail view.
